title: PromptContract: Seedance-Extend one-take schema + render-rule validator
purpose: Reusable schema (Python dataclasses) and validator for Seedance 2.5 Extend-style one-take continuation prompts. Turns the block structure observed in THREAD (art_01M66898SM32BY2E0RQQ92W66F r1) into an explicit interface: CameraWindow, FailedTakeRule, PromptContract, and check_render(). Intended as an integration contract between prompt author and render-review pipeline.
